Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli. Hematuria and proteinuria are present but mild. Low urine specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
